session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Sell Climax and Bull Reversal in TR Day'. BLACK FRIDAY SHORT SESSION: the axis runs 06:30-10:00 (plain PT mapping of the 09:30-13:00 ET holiday close), and this is the only calibration image so far with a straight-PT axis - useful offset reference. Reading: morning trading range 3637-3642 with a DT (red dotted 3642 line) and a rising wedge into the 07:40 top, breakdown under the short blue dotted line after 08:10, consecutive bear wedges (two magenta dotted falling lines) flushing to a sell climax of 3626 at 09:40 (green signal-box recovery), then a V bull reversal into the close about 3637 (day ends near its open). Chart title says TR day while the filename says climactic reversal day - treat the day-type framing carefully in review.
